title: Finance Systems Manager- crypto
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. We are seeking a qualified accountant with strong systems and project management experience to own the transformation of our internal inventory system. This is an individual contributor role at the intersection of finance operations, product management, and technology. You will act as product owner for the inventory platform — driving enhancements, integrations, and data migrations end-to-end. In a tech-crunch environment, you must be self-sufficient: comfortable building tools, scripts, and AI-driven workflows independently to solve problems without a dedicated engineering team.
